data.heading: Senior engineers, small teams, real ownership
data.description:
Vertex Labs was founded by engineers who were tired of handovers and hand-waving. We put small, senior teams on each product and keep them there for the long run.

Today 180 engineers, designers and SREs help fintech, health and commerce companies ship faster — and sleep better once their systems are live.

items.question: Do you work with early-stage startups?
items.answer: Yes. We offer MVP packages for funded startups and grow the team as you grow.

items.question: Who owns the code?
items.answer: You do. All code and IP are assigned to you from the first commit.

items.question: Can you take over an existing product?
items.answer: Yes. We start with a code and infrastructure audit, then plan a safe handover.

items.question: Which time zones do you support?
items.answer: Our teams overlap with India, Europe and US East working hours.

We use this information only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
